title: The Ministry of Adequate Happiness
setting_summary: In the vertical bureaucracy of the Central Bureau of Emotional Compliance, citizens must file daily happiness declarations in triplicate before their allotted two minutes of sunlight. A budget shortfall forces the Bureau to ration joy itself, and every article of the Universal Declaration becomes a form to be stamped, denied, or appealed within a nine-floor stairwell where the lift has been condemned as a security risk.
